description.value: Sieffert's Farm Market is a multi-generational family farm on the Comox peninsula that has been operating since the early 1960s, now with third and fourth generations working the land. The market grows roughly 100 acres of potatoes, 20 acres of corn, 30 acres of mixed vegetables, and 30,000 sq ft of greenhouses, supplementing their own harvest with in-season crops from other local BC farms and Okanagan fruit. It is a genuine farm-direct stop offering an exceptional variety of fresh seasonal produce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, publicly accessible farm market with extensive fresh produce offerings on the Comox peninsula, matching the OSM shop=farm tag. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, washrooms, bike rack, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all those fields are null. The website contact page lists '720 Knight Road' while OSM records '706 Knight Road' — a discrepancy flagged in concerns; the website value is used as more likely current.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '706 Knight Road' but the website contact page lists '720 Knight Road, Comox B.C. V9M3T3'. Website value used; OSM may need correction.
Operation is seasonal (late May to November 10th only); cyclists visiting outside this window will find it closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, publicly accessible farm market with broad fresh produce offerings on a cycling-friendly peninsula; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists during the seasonal window.
